description: Mobile network operator lookup for phone numbers in 17 African countries: Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, South Africa, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Zambia, Egypt, Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, Cameroon, Ethiopia, Malawi, Zimbabwe, Namibia and Mozambique. Returns the operator (MTN, Safaricom, Airtel, Glo, Vodacom, Orange and others) and the number in E.164 format. Useful before sending airtime, mobile money or SMS. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, needed only for numbers in local format (e.g. 0803 123 4567)

number.description: Phone number in international format (+2348031234567), or local format with country
